messages:
nina: massive thanks to @rashid and @facilities-team for saving yesterday's customer demo — the projector died and they hunted down a spare HDMI+adapter in under 6 minutes :tada:
rashid: ha, we were literally doing the USB tango in the back room. glad it worked! shoutout to @leo for rerouting the test traffic so the demo didn't hit rate limits :rocket:
leo: np! quick config tweak in the LB, <3 the teamwork. also big props to @olivia for keeping the slides calm and collected during the scramble :clap:
olivia: I was trying to channel my best presenter-zen. nobody knew about the chaos except us backstage :sweat_smile:
sam: can we put a small "spare cables" box in the demo room labeled with an emoji so future me won't panic? :raised_hands: @facilities-team?
facilities-team: Love that idea. We already have a small kit in Bldg A, but we'll add one to the demo booth and pin an inventory list. Also adding a tiny sign: "If found, high-fives appreciated." :house_with_garden:
rashid: also a tiny kudos to @deploy-bot — your Canary check rolled back the weird config right as we were about to flip to prod, so demo traffic stayed stable. :shield:
deploy-bot: deploy v2.3.14: canary -> stable succeeded (auto-rollback prevented)
nina: this was a true cross-team save: infra, facilities, product, and ops. team lunch on me tomorrow? small cupcakes at 12:30 in kitchen B. :cupcake: :heart:
sam: cupcakes + storytime of the Great HDMI Hunt = my schedule is cleared. i'll bring napkins. :grin:
leo: coming. and i call dibs on the lemon ones. :raised_hands:
olivia: thank you everyone — felt like a mini Broadway tight-knit crew for 10 minutes. proud to be on this team. :sparkles:
